classification.rationale: Artifact-registry crash recovery and cross-runtime lease behavior were uncertain before characterization; this execution tested those behaviors against Node and F# implementations.

rd.researchQuestion: Can Node and F# safely coordinate artifact-registry projection recovery through one lock and pending write record?
rd.technicalUncertainty: The prior implementation had atomic per-file writes but no cross-runtime artifact-registry lease or crash-replay record.
rd.experimentalObjective: Characterize lock ownership, stale recovery, and replay behavior without changing work or telemetry persistence authority.
